overview.difficulty: Varies by region, cultivar and management

season.general: Perennial; flowering regulation varies by region
season.note: Exact sowing/planting window depends on location, cultivar, irrigation and local weather.

soil.note: Good drainage and soil testing should guide field-specific decisions.

trainingDatasetProfile.note: These are observed ranges in the ML training data, not universal agronomic limits.

landPreparation: Remove major weeds and previous-crop residues as appropriate.
Prepare a workable seedbed or planting area suitable for the crop.
Correct obvious drainage problems before planting.
Base soil amendments on a soil test and local recommendations.

guidance: Use healthy, suitable seed or planting material.
Follow locally recommended spacing and planting depth for the chosen cultivar.
Avoid planting into severely waterlogged or excessively dry soil.
sowingOrPlanting.note: Exact seed rate, spacing and treatment vary by cultivar and production system.

guidance: Irrigate according to crop stage, soil moisture, rainfall and soil type.
Avoid prolonged waterlogging unless the production system specifically requires standing water.
Pay special attention to establishment and reproductive/yield-forming stages.
irrigation.note: Do not treat the ML rainfall feature as an irrigation prescription.

guidance: Use soil-test-based nutrient planning.
Split nutrient applications when locally recommended rather than applying everything at once.
Do not diagnose nutrient deficiency from leaf colour alone.
nutrition.note: Exact fertilizer dose is intentionally not hard-coded because it depends on soil test, yield target, cultivar and local extension guidance.
